name: Sengoku unification victory on the test map: raze, one castle missing, save/load, rebuild, then all

steps.code: local limit=GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAME_TURN_LIMIT'); if limit~=DB.MakeHash('TURNLIMIT_NONE') then error('turn limit not NONE: '..tostring(limit)) end; return 'turn limit NONE after Create Game setup'

local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total~=4 or total-owned~=2 then error('initial castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if not Game.IsVictoryEnabled('VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION') then error('unification victory disabled') end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('winner at start') end; return 'registered=4, two held by Date'

local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local target=nil; local capital=Players[date]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); for _,city in Players[date]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) and (not capital or city:GetID()~=capital:GetID()) then target=city end end; if not target then error('Date castle to raze missing') end; local owner,id=target:GetOwner(),target:GetID(); local how='DestroyCity'; if CityManager.DestroyCity then pcall(CityManager.DestroyCity,target) end; if CityManager.GetCity(owner,id) then how='fallback transfer (DestroyCity did not raze)'; CityManager.TransferCity(CityManager.GetCity(owner,id),0) end; return 'raze: '..how

local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total-owned~=1 then error('negative castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('victory with one castle missing') end; return 'negative: one castle missing ('..owned..'/'..total..'); no winner'
ViewGeneric('VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION'); if Controls.GenericView:IsHidden() then error('custom victory tab hidden') end; return 'World Rankings shows 天下統一 condition'

local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total-owned~=1 then error('negative castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('victory with one castle missing') end; return 'negative: one castle missing ('..owned..'/'..total..'); no winner'

local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total-owned~=1 then error('negative castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('victory with one castle missing') end; return 'negative: one castle missing ('..owned..'/'..total..'); no winner'

local coords={{6,5},{25,5},{6,14},{25,14}}; local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REBUILT_ON_CASTLE'].Index; local function razed(x,y) return Game:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_RAZED_CASTLE_PLOT_'..Map.GetPlot(x,y):GetIndex())==true end; local target=nil; for _,xy in ipairs(coords) do local city=CityManager.GetCityAt(xy[1],xy[2]); if razed(xy[1],xy[2]) then if city then error('razed plot has a city') end; if target then error('more than one razed plot') end; target=xy elseif not city then error('empty plot not recorded as razed: '..xy[1]..','..xy[2]) end end; if not target then error('no razed plot recorded (raze or turn-start scan failed)') end; local builder=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then builder=id end end; if not builder then error('Ashina missing') end; Players[builder]:GetCities():Create(target[1],target[2]); if not CityManager.GetCityAt(target[1],target[2]) then error('rebuild failed') end; return 'rebuilt '..target[1]..','..target[2]..' for Ashina'

local coords={{6,5},{25,5},{6,14},{25,14}}; local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REBUILT_ON_CASTLE'].Index; local function razed(x,y) return Game:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_RAZED_CASTLE_PLOT_'..Map.GetPlot(x,y):GetIndex())==true end; local n=0; for _,xy in ipairs(coords) do local city=CityManager.GetCityAt(xy[1],xy[2]); if city and razed(xy[1],xy[2]) then n=n+1; if not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then error('rebuilt city unmarked') end elseif city and city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then error('original castle marked') end end; if n~=1 then error('rebuilt cities '..n) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('winner before the last castle') end; return 'rebuilt city marked; no winner'

local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local last=nil; for _,city in Players[date]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) then if last then error('more than one castle held out') end; last=city end end; if not last then error('held out castle missing') end; CityManager.TransferCity(last,0); return 'transferred the last castle'

local coords={{6,5},{25,5},{6,14},{25,14}}; local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REBUILT_ON_CASTLE'].Index; local function razed(x,y) return Game:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_RAZED_CASTLE_PLOT_'..Map.GetPlot(x,y):GetIndex())==true end; local owned=0; local rebuilt=0; for _,xy in ipairs(coords) do local city=CityManager.GetCityAt(xy[1],xy[2]); if razed(xy[1],xy[2]) then rebuilt=rebuilt+1; if not city or not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then error('rebuilt city lost') end; if city:GetOwner()==0 then error('rebuilt city owned by Oda') end else if not city then error('castle missing at '..xy[1]..','..xy[2]) end; if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then error('castle marked as rebuilt: '..xy[1]..','..xy[2]) end; if city:GetOwner()==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end; if rebuilt~=1 or owned~=3 then error('after transfer owned '..owned..', rebuilt '..rebuilt) end; return 'all 3 castles held by Oda, none marked; rebuilt city marked'

local human=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); AutoplayManager.SetTurns(1); AutoplayManager.SetReturnAsPlayer(human); AutoplayManager.SetObserveAsPlayer(PlayerTypes.NONE); AutoplayManager.SetActive(true); return true

condition.code: local winner,v=Game.GetWinningTeam(); return winner==Players[0]:GetTeam() and v~=nil and GameInfo.Victories[v]~=nil and GameInfo.Victories[v].VictoryType=='VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION'
